mainEntity.name: Do I still need traditional SEO if I use AI SEO for my real estate website?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI SEO does not replace traditional SEO; rather, it enhances and streamlines it. AI tools use data-driven insights to inform and refine traditional SEO practices, such as keyword research, content creation, and technical optimization. Think of AI as a powerful co-pilot that makes your existing SEO efforts more efficient and effective. A comprehensive strategy integrates both AI-powered analysis and foundational SEO principles for best results.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI SEO enhances, not replaces, traditional SEO. It uses data to refine foundational SEO practices, making them more efficient and effective for real estate websites.
